articleBodyHtml:
Deception and Evidence

The speaker is recording evidence and intends to refute any claims of deception by having multiple recordings.

The speaker emphasizes the presence of multiple recordings and asserts their ability to detect lies.

The speaker accuses the other party of lying and points out the lack of recording devices.

The speaker claims the other party is lying to others and provides evidence of their own recording devices (iPad).

The speaker clarifies that an iPad is a phone, stating it is a large phone.

The speaker reiterates that the iPad is a phone and then notes that it is being discarded.
